# agent-workspace (vendored)

Drop-in 3D virtual office for AI agents.

- Source: https://github.com/kingpincloser/agent-workspace
- Copyright (c) 2026 HardLend.io — MIT (see LICENSE, retained as required)

Vendored rather than installed from npm so the scene can be adapted to Axiom's
council (six analysts, our own colours, our own live data). The MIT licence
grants the right to use, modify and distribute; the copyright notice stays.

NOTE: upstream ships a client-side freemium check (`licenseKey`, 3 agents /
1 room without one). MIT permits modifying it, and we do — but the author
clearly intends a paid tier, so if this ends up load-bearing for Axiom it is
worth supporting them.
